about: Scream If You Love shows Brock Lesnar, shaved head and bulging neck veins, bellowing at the camera with his mouth stretched wide open in the middle of a packed WWE arena. The caption sits above him in the form "scream if you love ___", so the GIF plays as Lesnar answering the call with the loudest, most unhinged yes possible. Half the fun is that the roar looks more like rage than affection, which makes it perfect for things people claim to love through gritted teeth: Friday deploys, group projects, a seventh patch for the same bug. Used sincerely, it is a hype reaction for something you genuinely adore.
origin: The footage is from WWE's WrestleMania 29 in April 2013, during Lesnar's appearance on the show. The clip of his scream was later turned into a GIF caption template, with early versions asking him to scream if he loved a particular country.
usage:
There is a single caption box above the GIF. Write the whole line as "scream if you love ___" and let Lesnar's roar be the answer. Keep the thing being loved short so the joke reads before the loop restarts.

Two flavors work. Ironic: name something everyone pretends to enjoy but secretly dreads, and the scream becomes pure suffering. Sincere: name a niche obsession (a cancelled show, a specific snack, a favorite map) and the scream becomes over-the-top fan energy. The ironic version usually gets more laughs because the face already looks furious.
